reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR on the front, and anyone can print that; I look for an NSF or USP seal and there isn't one. It's also $1.00 a day against about $0.39 for Nature Made, and a brand with zero reviews doesn't make me pay more than double.
objection: Lab-tested by a lab they picked themselves isn't the same as NSF or USP certified, and I'd be paying over twice my usual price per serving for a brand nobody has reviewed yet.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF Certified or USP Verified mark on the box, plus a few hundred real reviews, and a price closer to $0.60 a day.
